narrative.intro: Ameresco has $57.7M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date across seven awards. Ameresco has an average award size of $8.2M. Ameresco's obligations fell 81.4% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows variability: obligations were $122M in FY22, $107M in FY23, $75.8M in FY24, $541M in FY25, and $309M in FY26. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer in FY2027 to date, obligating $56.4M. The Department of Justice obligated $1.3M. The Department of the Interior obligated $33.4K. The General Services Administration and the National Archives and Records Administration have $0 in obligations to Ameresco in FY2027 to date. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in tables that are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. This snapshot highlights concentration with one agency and the recent decline in annual obligations compared with prior years.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Ameresco's FY2027 to date federal obligations?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $56.4M of Ameresco's $57.7M in FY2027 to date, showing heavy concentration in one buyer. The Department of Justice, the Department of the Interior, the General Services Administration, and the National Archives and Records Administration account for the remainder or zero obligations.

sections.heading: How have Ameresco's federal obligations changed over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Ameresco's obligations fell 81.4% year over year in the current fiscal-year-to-date comparison. Fiscal-year totals were $122M in FY22, $107M in FY23, $75.8M in FY24, $541M in FY25, and $309M in FY26.

faq.q: How much does Ameresco make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Ameresco has $57.7M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Ameresco has seven awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $8.2M. Ameresco's obligations fell 81.4% year over year.

The Department of Veterans Affairs buys most from Ameresco, obligating $56.4M in FY2027 to date. The Department of Justice obligated $1.3M and the Department of the Interior obligated $33.4K. The General Services Administration and the National Archives and Records Administration show $0 in obligations to Ameresco in FY2027 to date.
